# AUTO-GENERATED — tools/gen_acm_culture_list_effects.py
# 各大区独立 global list；GUI 用 VariableSystem + Concatenate 切换（打开窗时一次性填充）

skonester_acm_heritages_list_refresh_all_effect = {
  clear_global_variable_list = skonester_acm_heritage_list_all
  every_culture_global = {
    if = {
      limit = {
        NOT = {
          any_in_global_list = {
            variable = skonester_acm_heritage_list_all
            has_same_culture_heritage = prev
          }
        }
      }
      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = skonester_acm_heritage_list_all target = this }
    }
  }
}
